requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports only normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry. It has no re-export of executor.mjs, so executeAuthorizedPlan (executor.mjs:4) and runEligibleStops (executor.mjs:12) are not reachable through the public dispatch entry. Verified: typeof executeAuthorizedPlan on the index.mjs namespace is undefined.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `nextRetryDelay` applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided `retryAfter`.
finding: nextRetryDelay (retry.mjs:24) checks only the truthiness of retryAfter, so a finite retryAfter of 0 is ignored and computeBackoff applies (250 ms). dispatch-policy.md:16 requires a finite numeric retryAfter to replace the computed backoff. Verified: nextRetryDelay(0, 0) returned 250.

requirement: `executeAuthorizedPlan` rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executor.mjs:4 evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden (line 6) checks canPlanRoute, so dispatch runs for an unauthorized actor. Verified: an unauthorized call returned {ok:false,error:'forbidden'} after the dispatch function was invoked once.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `stopsForDriver` returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver (queue.mjs:30) compares only stop.driver and ignores stop.reassignment, but dispatch-policy.md:63 defines the assigned driver as the reassignment driver when a reassignment exists. Verified: stopsForDriver([{id:1,driver:'A',reassignment:{driver:'B'}}],'B') returned an empty list.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, `writePlanAtomically` renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `chooseDeparture` applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: chooseDeparture (schedule.mjs:3-7) returns the blackout-adjusted time from atUtcHour (lines 6, 20) without checking whether it is still inside the departure window (lines 1, 9). dispatch-policy.md:26 requires a departure chosen inside the window and then moved outside it to be refused. Verified: 2026-01-01T03:30Z returned 2026-01-01T05:00:00.000Z, which is outside the window ending at hour 4.

requirement: `redactNestedDriverToken` removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
`emitPlanCreated` emits `plan.created` only after storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated (executor.mjs:15) passes its emit call as onStored to savePlan, which forwards it only as the store.write option onCommit (storage.mjs:4). The staged code does not show when a store invokes onCommit, and storage-contract.md defines no plan write or onCommit contract (lines 9-15 cover only temporary-write operations). Whether plan.created is emitted only after successful storage cannot be determined from the staged bytes and the governing documents.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `hasDuplicateRouteKeys` reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: queue.mjs:18 builds each route identity as `${stop.depotId}${normalizeRouteKey(stop.routeKey)}` with no separator, so different identities collide. dispatch-policy.md:37-38 defines the identity as the depotId together with the normalized routeKey. Verified: stops {depotId:'A1',routeKey:'B'} and {depotId:'A',routeKey:'1B'} were reported as duplicates (true).

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `parseRetryCount` accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns a result whose `ok` is `false`.
finding: parseRetryCount (retry.mjs:4) uses Number(value), which accepts empty text, whitespace-padded text and other numeric syntax. dispatch-policy.md:43 accepts a text retry count only when it is one or more base-10 digits. Verified: parseRetryCount('') and parseRetryCount(' 2') both returned ok:true.

requirement: `remainingVehicleCapacity` never returns a negative value.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `pendingStops` returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops (executor.mjs:19) excludes only state 'delivered', but dispatch-policy.md:64 defines a delivered stop as one whose state is 'delivered' or 'handedOver'. Verified: pendingStops([{id:1,state:'handedOver'}]) kept the handedOver stop.

requirement: `previewPlan` returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
`redactAccessLog` removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
`orderedDestinationGroups` returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: orderedDestinationGroups (manifest.mjs:42) passes the Map returned by groupByDestination (lines 3-9) to orderManifestGroups (line 11). Spreading a Map yields [key, records] entries that have no destination property, so the comparator returns 0 and insertion order is kept. Verified: records with destinations 'B' then 'A' produced group keys ['B','A'].

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md`, `routeDistance` rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
`savePlan` validates a plan before the first persistent write.
`computeBackoff` doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
`retryTransient` permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
Under `docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md`, `locateStops` leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: locateStops (queue.mjs:34) keeps only stops whose lookup result is not undefined. adapter-contracts.md:3 defines geocoder.lookup only for a known address and does not state the result for an unknown address. Exclusion of unknown addresses therefore depends on unspecified adapter behavior, and a rejected lookup would reject the whole Promise.all instead of leaving the stop out. This cannot be determined from the staged bytes and the governing contract.

requirement: `retainScheduleOffset` preserves the supplied offset exactly.
`runEligibleStops` skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `withinVehicleCapacity` accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity (capacity.mjs:3) returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0. remainingVehicleCapacity returns 0 for an equal total (capacity.mjs:12), so a total equal to the configured limit is refused. Verified: withinVehicleCapacity(10000, 10) returned false.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `canPlanRoute` treats an actor holding `routes:admin` as owning every depot.
finding: canPlanRoute (access.mjs:3) grants the ownership bypass only when actor.scopes includes routes:admin. dispatch-policy.md:9-10 define held scopes as the actor's own scopes plus the scope of every active claim, so an admin held through an active claim does not own every depot. Verified: an actor with own routes:plan and an active routes:admin claim was refused for a route on depot X (returned false).

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `canPlanRoute` refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes (access.mjs:5) keeps the active claim scopes of a suspended actor, and canPlanRoute (access.mjs:3) accepts them. dispatch-policy.md:11 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and held scopes include claim scopes (line 10). Verified: a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim on depot D was allowed to plan a route on depot D (returned true).

requirement: `selectActiveClaims` excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
`checksumPlan` hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
`safeAnnouncement` omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
`encodeUtf8` encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
`manifestEntryIsValid` rejects blank package IDs.
Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, `publishWithAnnouncement` removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure (manifest.mjs:32) removes the object returned by store.get. storage-contract.md:6 defines get as resolving to a new copy, and storage-contract.md:7 says remove deletes only the exact stored object, so the copy removes nothing. Verified with a store that follows this contract: after an announcement failure, manifest M1 was still stored.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `redactManifestEvent` removes every credential nested below an `auth` field.
finding: stripCredentials (telemetry.mjs:14) recurses only into values whose constructor is Object, so credentials inside arrays nested under auth are kept. dispatch-policy.md:48 requires removal at every depth of the redacted value. Verified: redactManifestEvent({auth:{sessions:[{token:'x'}]}}) kept the token.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, `chunkManifest` limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, `publishWithAnnouncement` waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
`serializeManifestRecords` emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
`orderManifestGroups` orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `manifestRecipients` lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a `phone`.
`publicationResult` returns structured success and failure variants.
`normalizedPlanKey` trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
`buildManifest` copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: buildManifest (manifest.mjs:26) copies each record with a spread, but labelDriver (manifest.mjs:34) calls Object.assign on the driver object that the copy shares with the supplied record, so the supplied record is changed. Verified: after buildManifest with driver label ' a ', the supplied record's label was 'a'.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `publishWithRetry` stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
`publishManifest` stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: publishManifest (publisher.mjs:5-6) maps entries through an async arrow, so checks holds Promise objects and checks.every(Boolean) is always true. Invalid manifests are therefore staged (publisher.mjs:7). Verified: a manifest with a blank packageId returned ok:true and store.put was called once.

requirement: `successTelemetry` records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
`groupByDestination` groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `departureMinute` is a stop's `arrivalMinute` plus its service time.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, `publishWithRetry` retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: asPublicationError (publisher.mjs:19) marks a failure transient when it has a finite retryAfter, even when transient is false. Under the policy preamble (dispatch-policy.md:3) the later rule at line 54 overrides the rule at line 53 where both apply, so a failure marked transient: false is never transient. Verified: a failure with transient:false and retryAfter:1 was attempted twice.

requirement: `preserveManifestDriver` trims driver labels without changing letter case.
`coalescePackages` removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups (manifest.mjs:37-38) filters each group against seen, but seen holds raw IDs (line 38) while the group IDs are normalized by normalizePackageIds (normalize.mjs:11). An ID with surrounding whitespace in one group therefore does not match the same ID in a later group. Verified: groups with ' P1' and 'P1' returned [['P1'],['P1']].

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
finding: routeDuration (queue.mjs:32) adds serviceMinutes but not the 5 minutes of parking that dispatch-policy.md:65 includes in a stop's service time. Verified: routeDuration([{travelMinutes:1,serviceMinutes:2}]) returned 3 instead of 8.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: stripCredentials (telemetry.mjs:14) recurses only into values whose constructor is Object, so credentials inside arrays nested under auth are kept. dispatch-policy.md:48 requires removal at every depth of the redacted value. Verified: redactManifestEvent({auth:{sessions:[{token:'x'}]}}) kept the token.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
`savePlan` completes validation before its first write.
Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure (manifest.mjs:32) removes the object returned by store.get. storage-contract.md:6 defines get as resolving to a new copy, and storage-contract.md:7 says remove deletes only the exact stored object, so the copy removes nothing. Verified with a store that follows this contract: after an announcement failure, manifest M1 was still stored.

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups (manifest.mjs:37-38) filters each group against seen, but seen holds raw IDs (line 38) while the group IDs are normalized by normalizePackageIds (normalize.mjs:11). An ID with surrounding whitespace in one group therefore does not match the same ID in a later group. Verified: groups with ' P1' and 'P1' returned [['P1'],['P1']].

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: storage.mjs:9 calls store.discardTemporary() after renameTemporary rejects. storage-contract.md:11 leaves the temporary bytes in place and locked after a rejected rename, and storage-contract.md:13 says discardTemporary keeps locked bytes. Only store.removeTemporary() deletes locked bytes (storage-contract.md:14), and storage.mjs does not call it, so the temporary bytes are not removed when the rename fails.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, `publishManifest` returns, in a success result, the manifest object that `store.put` durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: canAssignAllPackages (capacity.mjs:14) delegates to withinVehicleCapacity (line 3), which returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0. remainingVehicleCapacity returns 0 for an equal total (capacity.mjs:12), so an equal total is refused. Verified: withinVehicleCapacity(10000, 10) returned false.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports only normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry. It has no re-export of executor.mjs, so executeAuthorizedPlan (executor.mjs:4), executeDryRun (line 8), runEligibleStops (line 12), emitPlanCreated (line 14) and pendingStops (line 19) are not reachable through the public dispatch entry. Verified: typeof executeAuthorizedPlan on the index.mjs namespace is undefined.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: withSortedKeys (serialize.mjs:1) wraps only the top-level object. Nested objects reach JSON.stringify unchanged, so their key order stays in the serialized text and in checksumPlan (line 7). Verified: serializePlan({a:{y:1,x:2}}) differs from serializePlan({a:{x:2,y:1}}).

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: partitionUrgentStops (queue.mjs:22-23) tests priorityOf(stop) for urgent but the raw stop.priority for remaining. A stop with priority Infinity falls into neither partition: priorityOf returns 5 (not urgent) and !(Infinity > 5) is false. Verified: partitionUrgentStops([{id:1,priority:Infinity}]) returned zero stops in both partitions.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: nextDispatchTime (schedule.mjs:15) calls candidate.getHours(), which returns the host local hour, while dispatch-policy.md:22 makes all departure hours UTC hours. The blackout test and the same-day move (lines 15, 18, 20) therefore depend on the host time zone instead of the UTC hour.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated (executor.mjs:15) passes its emit call as onStored to savePlan, which forwards it only as the store.write option onCommit (storage.mjs:4). The staged code does not show when a store invokes onCommit, and storage-contract.md defines no plan write or onCommit contract (lines 9-15 cover only temporary-write operations). Whether plan.created is emitted only after successful storage cannot be determined from the staged bytes and the governing documents.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Under `docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md`, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
`toStableJson` uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
`orderManifestGroups` orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
finding: compareStops (queue.mjs:6) subtracts raw sequence values. A string sequence is coerced, so '3' sorts as 3, and NaN gives a zero comparison. dispatch-policy.md:33 requires a stop without a finite numeric sequence to follow every equal-priority stop that has one. Verified: stop 'b' with sequence '3' sorted before stop 'a' with sequence 5.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch (access.mjs:8-9) returns firstRejected <= 0, so a batch whose first route fails depot ownership (index 0) is accepted, and only a later failure rejects the batch. Verified: authorizeRouteBatch({depotId:'D',scopes:[]}, [{depotId:'X'},{depotId:'D'}]) returned true.

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: weighPackages (capacity.mjs:20) stores the value returned by scale.read as the package weight without conversion. dispatch-policy.md:58 requires grams, but adapter-contracts.md:8 defines scale.read only as the measured weight and states no unit. The unit of the stored value cannot be determined from the staged bytes and the governing contracts.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
`normalizeRouteKey` applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit `utf8` encoding name.
Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: effectiveScopes (access.mjs:5) keeps the active claim scopes of a suspended actor, and canPlanRoute (access.mjs:3) accepts them. dispatch-policy.md:11 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and held scopes include claim scopes (line 10). Verified: a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim on depot D was allowed to plan a route on depot D (returned true).

requirement: Under `docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md`, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: sendDeliveryNotices (publisher.mjs:31) passes entry.phone unchanged to sms.send for every entry. dispatch-policy.md:66 defines the contact phone with spaces and hyphens removed, and an entry without a phone would be sent to undefined. Verified: phone '555-01 23' was passed unchanged.
